note: 背景与光型编号库。bg_rgb 为可校验目标值，tolerance 为容许色差范围。

backdrops.light_zh: 正面柔光箱加下方补光，下巴无明显阴影，背景独立打亮
backdrops.light_en: Front softbox plus under-fill, no chin shadow, background lit separately
backdrops.use_for: 签证类、门禁人脸库、批量工卡
backdrops.prompt_zh: 纯白无缝背景，背景独立打亮无灰阶渐变，人物边缘干净不糊
backdrops.prompt_en: seamless pure white backdrop lit independently with no grey falloff, clean subject separation

backdrops.light_zh: 45 度主光加反射板，背景留轻微中心亮、边缘暗
backdrops.light_en: 45-degree key with reflector, slight center brightness and edge falloff
backdrops.use_for: 企业工卡、官网团队页、简历照
backdrops.prompt_zh: 浅灰渐变影棚背景，中心略亮四周柔和收暗，整体通透干净
backdrops.prompt_en: light grey studio gradient, brighter at center with soft edge falloff, airy and clean overall

backdrops.light_zh: 柔光主光加轻微轮廓光，人物与背景明度分离
backdrops.light_en: Soft key with slight rim light, subject separated by brightness
backdrops.use_for: 创意与职能岗、对外沟通头像
backdrops.prompt_zh: 中性纯色灰背景，均匀无杂斑，人物有轻微轮廓光与背景分离
backdrops.prompt_en: even neutral grey backdrop free of mottling, subject separated by a subtle rim light

backdrops.light_zh: 较高对比硬光，主光位偏高，塑造权威线条
backdrops.light_en: Higher-contrast harder key placed high, sculpting authoritative lines
backdrops.prompt_zh: 深藏青纯色背景，主光位略高、对比明确，肩线与背景清晰分离
backdrops.prompt_en: deep navy solid backdrop, slightly elevated key with defined contrast, shoulders cleanly separated

backdrops.light_zh: 高调柔光，几乎无阴影，色彩偏冷白
backdrops.light_en: High-key soft light, near-shadowless, cool-white cast
backdrops.prompt_zh: 浅蓝绿医疗色系背景，高调明亮、阴影极弱，画面洁净无杂物
backdrops.prompt_en: pale blue-green clinical backdrop, high-key with minimal shadows, spotless and clutter-free

backdrops.light_zh: 侧位柔光保留纸纹明暗，人物光略暖
backdrops.light_en: Side soft light keeping paper texture, subject light slightly warm
backdrops.prompt_zh: 暖色微纹理纸面背景，可见极细纹理但不喧宾，人物光柔和偏暖
backdrops.prompt_en: warm finely textured paper backdrop with visible but quiet grain, soft slightly warm subject light

backdrops.light_zh: 窗光为主加室内环境光，背景虚化控制在中等程度
backdrops.light_en: Window key with ambient fill, moderate background blur
backdrops.use_for: 对外销售、门店店长、顾问
backdrops.prompt_zh: 办公环境轻度虚化背景，可辨认空间但不出现文字与人脸，主体清晰
backdrops.prompt_en: lightly blurred office setting, space readable but no legible text or other faces, subject sharp
backdrops.batch_risk: 批量场景不建议使用：环境光难统一，会导致整批不一致

backdrops.light_zh: 按品牌 VI 色值打背景，需先录入客户 RGB
backdrops.light_en: Match the client's VI color value; RGB must be supplied first
backdrops.use_for: 企业统一工卡、连锁门店
backdrops.prompt_zh: 客户品牌指定纯色背景，色值严格一致，全批次不得漂移
backdrops.prompt_en: client-specified brand solid backdrop held to exact color value across the whole batch
